description: Desktop app for ToolHive, built with Electron, React, TypeScript, and Vite. Covers developing, testing, and packaging the app, its connection to the embedded thv binary, deep links, and branding.
rules: ToolHive Studio is managed with pnpm. Use the Node.js version pinned in `.nvmrc`, and keep the Docker daemon running during development.
Expose runtime configuration through `VITE_`-prefixed variables read from `import.meta.env`, not `process.env`. Never put secrets in them, because packaged Electron apps can be decompiled.
Don't hand-edit the generated API client in `common/api/generated`. Run `pnpm run generate-client` to regenerate it from the ToolHive OpenAPI spec.
The app talks to its embedded `thv` over a UNIX socket (a named pipe on Windows). To test a custom `thv` build, run `thv serve --openapi --socket=<path>` and start the app with `THV_SOCKET=<path>`.
For ToolHive CLI, Kubernetes operator, and vMCP usage, see the ToolHive documentation at docs.stacklok.com/toolhive.
